turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
I know who you are. Who decided on the zero?
I have 140 students. I don't have time to be cross-examined by every parent with a law degree.
Then you'll want to be quick about the one in front of you. Owen's zero, Hale. Who decided, and when?
You don't get to talk to me like I'm on the stand.
Then answer like someone who isn't. Who decided?
